2607.08554.title: CommuniWave:A Machine Learning Model for Quantifying the Degree of Temporary Informal Behavior in Urban Communities
2607.08554.paper_summary: For urban managers and designers, improving the functional attributes of urban communities to enhance territorial resilience in the face of complexity and uncertainty is crucial. Currently, community planning often follows a top-down approach and lacks effective metrics to quantify informal behaviors of residents, leading to frequent conflicts with original plans. This study introduces CommuniWave, a machine learning model designed to efficiently detect and quantify the Degree of Informal Behavior (DIB) in urban communities. The model integrates a Behavior Capture Net (BCN) based on mmaction2, a self-developed YOLOv10 model (YLX), and a Behavior Eval Model (BEM) using random forest. Ultimately, by generating DIB fluctuation charts from street videos, the model facilitates dynamic monitoring, supporting urban managers in making refined decisions to enhance the overall resilience of communities.
2607.08554.paper_summary_zh: 對於城市管理者和設計師來說，提高城市社區的功能屬性，以增強面對複雜性和不確定性的區域韌性是至關重要的。<lb/>目前，社區規劃通常遵循自上而下的方法，並缺乏有效的指標來量化居民的非正式行為，導致與原始計劃之間經常發生衝突。<lb/>本研究介紹了CommuniWave，一種旨在有效檢測和量化城市社區中非正式行為程度（DIB）的機器學習模型。<lb/>該模型整合了一個基於mmaction2的行為捕捉網（BCN）、一個自開發的YOLOv10模型（YLX）以及一個使用隨機森林的行為評估模型（BEM）。<lb/>最終，通過從街道視頻生成DIB波動圖，該模型促進了動態監測，支持城市管理者做出精細決策，以增強社區的整體韌性。
